threads.body: [General] These metrics are only registered when the JVM exposes `UnixOperatingSystemMXBean` (`FileDescriptor.java:51-52`), so they are absent on non-Unix systems. Please document that platform restriction to avoid implying that enabling experimental JMX metrics always produces them.
